changes.detail: Added required source URL, original authors, DOI, concrete IJCAI permission statement and URL, converter lineage, original conversion hash, and a visible linked copyright-holder reference.

Figure 1 preserves matrix cell memberships and independent, intersectional, and gerrymandering group sets. Figure 2 preserves taxonomy nodes and edges. Figure 3 preserves the nested MC1=MA, MC2, MCk, MC hierarchy and complexity direction.
Equations (1) through (9) and the unnumbered multiaccuracy constraint were transcribed as LaTeX from the rendered original.
Table 1 now has one row for each dataset with its exact Type and Demographics entries.

limits: Text descriptions preserve the semantic content inspected in Figures 1 to 3 but do not reproduce their visual layout or color encoding.
The mathematical transcription was checked visually against the publisher PDF but has not received an independent mathematical copy-edit.
Existing OCR and spacing defects elsewhere in the Docling body remain unchanged.
The IJCAI permission is recorded as the concrete publication permission supplied for this task; no Creative Commons licence is claimed.
